item.title: Chai Masala

item.content:encoded: Inspired by traditional Indian recipes, our Chai Masala is a bold blend of black tea and spices like cinnamon, ginger, cardamom, and cloves. This warming tea offers a rich and spicy flavor with a hint of sweetness, perfect for cozying up on cold days. Add milk and sugar for a classic chai experience.

item.title: Jasmine Green Tea
item.dc:creator: teadrop host
item.description: Our Jasmine Green Tea is a fragrant and soothing blend, featuring high-quality green tea leaves delicately scented with real jasmine blossoms. This aromatic tea is perfect for relaxation and offers a slightly sweet floral flavor that lingers with every sip. Ideal for unwinding at any time of the day.

item.content:encoded: A timeless blend of premium black tea infused with the delicate aroma of bergamot, Classic Earl Grey delivers a smooth and balanced taste with citrus notes and floral undertones. Perfect for morning and afternoon tea, this blend pairs well with a slice of lemon or a splash of milk for a classic touch
